thread:
maria: Quick sync — we want to flip on the per-customer toggle for Saturn to enable smart-routing for their account. Plan is a 10% traffic canary starting 09:00 UTC tomorrow. Need preflight sign-off (QA, SRE, Sales) and confirm kill-switch + contract gating are wired.

sam: sounds good. who owns the kill-switch?

devon: I can own the kill-switch and monitor metrics. I'll add a runbook entry and a Grafana dash for success/error rates.

elyse: @devon pls include latency p50/p95 and routing fallback rate. Also we need a note for the sales rep about VIP scope.

maria: Sales contact is @ben, contract allows this feature for Saturn but only for prod via per-customer flag; rollout must respect the "contract_feature_list" field. Ben — can you confirm?

ben: confirmed, Saturn has feature entitlement. Add the contract id CID-4821 to the flag metadata. Also VIP customers require an email to account manager on enable.

raj: Quick dev check — is the toggle implemented as tenant-scoped flag or via runtime policy? I prefer tenant-scoped feature flag + enforcement in router.

maria: Tenant-scoped. We'll use the customer toggle service with an allowlist config. Example config below (devon, please sanity check):

```
{
  "feature": "smart-routing",
  "scope": "tenant",
  "tenant_id": "saturn",
  "canary_percent": 10,
  "contract_id": "CID-4821",
  "kill_switch": "/flags/saturn/smart-routing/kill"
}
```

devon: config looks fine. For kill_switch I want a path that our ops tooling can toggle via API and UI. I'll create `/ops/flags/saturn/smart-routing/off` as a shortcut that triggers immediate fallback.

support-bot: NOTE: When toggles change the support ticketing webhook will post to #support. Make sure to include the short reason: "Saturn canary start".

maria: Also adding safety guards: auto-roll-back if error rate increases >3% over baseline for 5m OR latency p95 increases by 200ms. Devon — can you add those thresholds to the rollout policy?

devon: adding policy now. Will include automatic rollback and an alert to @sre-oncall and @maria.

sam: CI / code review: there's a small router PR that gates on tenant flag, @elyse can you give a quick LGTM? PR: https://git.company/repo/pull/2247

elyse: I'll review in an hour. Focus areas: ensure KV cache invalidation for seat changes and that the per-tenant cache TTL is correct.

ben: Sales side checked — will send the account manager email at kickoff and notify Saturn support contact.

maria: Ops checklist before 09:00 UTC tomorrow:
- confirm PR merged and deployed to canary instances
- devon to provision Grafana + alerts
- QA to run smoke prompts against Saturn sample dataset
- ben to notify account team
- set kill-switch and test toggling via curl (example below)

```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN" https://ops-api.internal/flags/saturn/smart-routing/off -d '{"reason":"test-kill-switch"}'
```

raj: one more: make sure the model variant fallback is pinned to the older model id (model-v1) to avoid surprise.

devon: confirmed, router will fallback to model-v1 and log routing reason.

maria: if everyone here is good, I'll schedule the canary and create the rollout ticket. Reply with :+1: when you approve.

sre-oncall: :+1: from SRE, just ensure the alert paging is enabled and escalation path is set.

elyse: :+1: QA will be ready.

ben: :+1: sales/accounting done.

support-bot: Reminder: ticket webhook test passed in staging.

maria: Great — I'll create the rollout ticket and set the start time. Thanks all, will post the ticket link once created.
